name: Clare Bambra
researchKeywords: health inequalities, north-south health divide, place and health, health equity
bio: Clare Bambra, PhD, FMedSci, FAcSS, HonFPH, Leopoldina, is Professor of Public Health. Her work focuses on understanding and reducing health inequalities, and she has published more than 300 books and articles.
researchFocus: Clare leads major research collaborations on health inequalities, including a Wellcome Trust-funded project examining the north-south health divide. Her international work includes health equity, place-based solutions and inequalities in access to infectious disease interventions.
